Spec-compliant MIME parser and creator.

Covers RFC 5322 (Internet message format), RFC 2045 (MIME part one), RFC 2046 (media types), RFC 2047 (encoded words), RFC 2048 (registration procedures) and RFC 2049 (conformance and examples), plus minimal RFC 2183 / RFC 2231 support for Content-Disposition filenames.

import openparser/mime
let msg = parseMime(readFile("mail.eml"))
echo msg.subject.get("")
writeFile("out.eml", toMime(msg))

MimeAddress = object
  case kind*: MimeAddressKind
  of maMailbox:
    mailbox*: MimeMailbox
  of maGroup:
    groupName*: string
    members*: seq[MimeMailbox]
MimeAddressKind = enum
  maMailbox, maGroup
MimeBody = object
  case kind*: MimeBodyKind
  of mbEmpty:
    nil
  of mbText:
    text*: string
    charset*: string
    raw*: seq[byte]
  of mbData:
    data*: seq[byte]
  of mbMultipart:
    subtype*: string
    boundary*: string
    preamble*: string
    parts*: seq[MimePart]
    epilogue*: string
  of mbMessage:
    message*: MimeMessage
MimeBodyKind = enum
  mbEmpty, mbText, mbData, mbMultipart, mbMessage
MimeContentType = object
  mainType*: string
  subType*: string
  params*: seq[MimeParam]
MimeDate = object
  raw*: string
  year*, month*, day*: int
  hour*, minute*, second*: int
  offsetMinutes*: Option[int]
  zone*: string
RFC 5322 date-time. raw preserves the original field body, zone preserves named zones, offsetMinutes holds the numeric offset when known. 
MimeDisposition = object
  kind*: string
  params*: seq[MimeParam]
Minimal RFC 2183 content disposition (e.g. attachment filenames). 
MimeHeader = object
  name*: string
  value*: string
A single unfolded raw header field. 
MimeMailbox = object
  displayName*: Option[string]
  localPart*: string
  domain*: string
MimeMessage = ref object
  date*: Option[MimeDate]
  fromAddrs*: seq[MimeMailbox]
  sender*: Option[MimeMailbox]
  replyTo*: seq[MimeMailbox]
  toAddrs*: seq[MimeAddress]
  cc*: seq[MimeAddress]
  bcc*: seq[MimeAddress]
  subject*: Option[string]
  messageId*: Option[string]
  inReplyTo*: seq[string]
  references*: seq[string]
  comments*: Option[string]
  keywords*: seq[string]
  received*: seq[string]
  returnPath*: Option[string]
  mimeVersion*: Option[string]
  body*: MimePart
  extraHeaders*: seq[MimeHeader]
A top-level RFC 5322 message: originator/recipient headers plus the MIME body entity. 
MimeOptions = object
  policy*: MimePolicy = mpLenient ## Default policy is lenient-first; strict opts into RFC enforcement.
  allowLf*: bool = true      ## Accept lone LF (and CR) line endings on input. Output is CRLF.
  maxDepth*: int = 8         ## Maximum nesting depth for multipart and message/rfc822 bodies.
  maxParts*: int = 100       ## Maximum total MIME parts in one message.
  maxHeaderBytes*: int = 1000000 ## Maximum bytes of a header block (headers only, not body).
  maxBodyBytes*: int = 50000000 ## Maximum bytes of transfer-decoded body content collected.
  decodeCharsets*: bool = true ## Convert text bodies to UTF-8 using the declared charset.
  foldAt*: int = 78          ## Preferred header folding column on output (never exceeds 998).
  lineEnding*: string = "\r\n" ## Line ending used when creating messages.
MimeParam = object
  name*: string
  value*: string
  charset*: Option[string]
  language*: Option[string]
A Content-Type / Content-Disposition parameter. RFC 2231 continuations (filename*0*, filename*1*) are reassembled into a single param with charset / language preserved. 
MimePart = ref object
  contentType*: MimeContentType
  contentTypePresent*: bool
  transferEncoding*: MimeTransferEncoding
  transferEncodingRaw*: string
  transferEncodingPresent*: bool
  contentId*: Option[string]
  contentDescription*: Option[string]
  disposition*: Option[MimeDisposition]
  contentLanguage*: seq[string]
  contentLocation*: Option[string]
  body*: MimeBody
  extraHeaders*: seq[MimeHeader]
A single MIME entity: content headers plus a decoded body. 
MimePolicy = enum
  mpLenient, mpStrict
Parsing/creation policy. Lenient recovers where safe and preserves unknown tokens; strict turns those recoveries into errors. 
MimeTransferEncoding = enum
  te7bit, te8bit, teBinary, teQuotedPrintable, teBase64, teUnknown
OpenParserMimeError = object of CatchableError
